title: 도서관 회원증 만들기: 무엇을 한 다음에 빌려요?
objective: You can ask for a library card and talk about steps in order using -은/ㄴ 다음에.
summary: Learn how to ask for a library card and follow the staff's steps.
setting: The front desk of a public library in Seoul. Mark, a foreign resident, wants to borrow books for the first time.

task.title: Use the library card words
task.line: Read the dialogue again, then answer each question with the words and the -은/ㄴ 다음에 pattern from this worksheet.

words.exampleMeaning: I left my library card at home.
Please write your name and phone number on the form.
Could you show me your ID?

words.meaning: residence card for foreigners (alien registration card)
words.exampleMeaning: Please write the address shown on your residence card.
I lost my wallet, so I don't have my ID.
Where do I apply to get a new card?

words.meaning: after doing ~ (use -은 after a final consonant, -ㄴ after a vowel)
words.example: 밥을 먹은 다음에 도서관에 갈 거예요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'll go to the library after I eat.

dialogue.korean: 책을 빌리고 싶은데 회원증이 없어요. 여기서 만들 수 있어요?
dialogue.meaning: I want to borrow books, but I don't have a library card. Can I make one here?

dialogue.korean: 네. 이 신청서를 쓴 다음에 신분증과 같이 주세요.
dialogue.meaning: Yes. Fill out this form, and then give it to me with your ID.

dialogue.korean: 다 썼어요. 신청서하고 외국인등록증 여기 있어요.
dialogue.meaning: I'm done. Here are the form and my residence card.

dialogue.korean: 확인했습니다. 여기 회원증이요. 책은 고른 다음에 이쪽 대출 데스크로 가져오세요.
dialogue.meaning: All checked. Here's your card. After you choose your books, bring them to this checkout desk.

dialogue.korean: 감사합니다. 그런데 회원증을 잃어버리면 어떻게 해요?
dialogue.meaning: Thank you. By the way, what should I do if I lose my card?

dialogue.korean: 그럴 때는 신분증을 가지고 오셔서 재발급을 받으시면 돼요.
dialogue.meaning: In that case, bring your ID and get a new card issued.

exercises: Fill in the blank with the -은/ㄴ 다음에 form of the verb in brackets: 회원증을 (받다) ____ 비밀번호를 정하세요.
Choose the right word: 회원증을 잃어버려서 (대출 / 재발급)을 받았어요.
Join the two sentences with -은/ㄴ 다음에: ① 사진을 찍어요. 신청서에 붙여요. ② 영화를 봐요. 감상문을 써요.
Answer in Korean based on the dialogue: 마크 씨는 회원증을 만들 때 직원에게 무엇을 줬어요?
answers: ① 사진을 찍은 다음에 신청서에 붙여요. ② 영화를 본 다음에 감상문을 써요.
